ne of the most important things for a first-timer to know about the Bear Original is that it can take some time to adjust to. 💡

It might feel quite firm for the first few nights, but it's designed to soften and break in over the first month of use. This mattress is generally considered ideal for back and stomach sleepers due to its firm, supportive feel. Side sleepers might find it puts a bit more pressure on their shoulders and hips.
